about.en: TST (Test) is a memecoin on BNB Smart Chain that began as a token deployed on the Four.meme launchpad in January 2025 for a BNB Chain tutorial video and was then taken over by its community. It is a BEP-20 token at 0x86bb94ddd16efc8bc58e6b056e8df71d9e666429 with a 1,000,000,000 supply and has no protocol or issuer behind it.
